lowDiskSpace.toast.message: {platform, select, macos {Your startup disk is running low on space: {freeText} free ({percentText}%).} windows {Your system drive is running low on space: {freeText} free ({percentText}%).} other {Your system disk is running low on space: {freeText} free ({percentText}%).}}

@lowDiskSpace.toast.message.description: Body of the persistent in-app warning toast when the startup (boot) disk is low on free space, e.g. 'Your startup disk is running low on space: 4.2 GB free (3.1%).'. 'startup disk' (the macOS branch) is the macOS term for the boot volume; the Windows branch says 'system drive' and the Linux branch 'system disk'. Use each OS's own term in your language.

placeholders.freeText: amount of free space, already formatted with its unit (e.g. 4.2 GB)
placeholders.percentText: free space as a percentage, already formatted with at least one decimal (e.g. 3.1, or 0.04 below one percent)

@lowDiskSpace.toast.disable.description: Button on the low-disk-space warning toast that turns the warning off and opens its settings. A short button label.

@lowDiskSpace.toast.closeTooltip.description: Tooltip on the small close (x) button of the low-disk-space warning toast. A short verb.

lowDiskSpace.notification.title: Low disk space

@lowDiskSpace.notification.title.description: Title of the OS's system notification warning that the startup disk (the drive the system runs from) is low on space. A short headline.

lowDiskSpace.notification.body: {platform, select, macos {{freeText} free ({percentText}%) on your startup disk.} windows {{freeText} free ({percentText}%) on your system drive.} other {{freeText} free ({percentText}%) on your system disk.}}

@lowDiskSpace.notification.body.description: Body of the OS's system notification warning of low disk space, e.g. '4.2 GB free (3.1%) on your startup disk.'. 'startup disk' (the macOS branch) is the macOS term for the boot volume; the Windows branch says 'system drive' and the Linux branch 'system disk'. Use each OS's own term in your language.

placeholders.freeText: amount of free space, already formatted with its unit (e.g. 4.2 GB)
placeholders.percentText: free space as a percentage, already formatted with at least one decimal (e.g. 3.1, or 0.04 below one percent)
